text: Now the whole platform goes into that bank, and Aziz walks his journey one last time.

text: Each zone gets one Linux host, and each host runs its own installation.
prefix: Each zone gets one Linux host, and each host runs its own installation.

text: Each unit is an image, and Docker Compose runs one copy of each image on the host.
prefix: Each unit is an image, and Docker Compose runs one copy of each image on the host.

text: This set of units is the Compose stack.
prefix: This set of units is the Compose stack.

text: In front run the two gateways, Keycloak, the workers, and four adapters: MyID, TAF, SMS and push.
prefix: In front run the two gateways, Keycloak, the workers, and four adapters: MyID, TAF, SMS and push.

text: Behind them run Postgres, Valkey, Kafka and Vault, and each one is new for that zone.
prefix: Behind them run Postgres, Valkey, Kafka and Vault, and each one is new for that zone.

text: Then OpenTofu does what Lesson 4 showed.
prefix: Then OpenTofu does what Lesson 4 showed.

text: It gives the deploy values of the zone, and the defaults for every policy and every text.
prefix: It gives the deploy values of the zone, and the defaults for every policy and every text.

text: It also writes the settings and the secrets of each unit into Vault.
prefix: It also writes the settings and the secrets of each unit into Vault.

text: An install script reads them from Vault and starts the stack.
prefix: An install script reads them from Vault and starts the stack.

text: If one value is missing, the start stops with a clear error.
prefix: If one value is missing, the start stops with a clear error.

text: Vault starts sealed: it holds the keys, but it cannot use them.
prefix: Vault starts sealed: it holds the keys, but it cannot use them.

text: It opens only with the unseal keys, and the bank's security team keeps them.
prefix: It opens only with the unseal keys, and the bank's security team keeps them.

text: So the platform team starts the stack, and the security team opens Vault.
prefix: So the platform team starts the stack, and the security team opens Vault.

text: Now the stack runs, but customers still cannot come in.
prefix: Now the stack runs, but customers still cannot come in.

text: The installation opens for customers only when the bank has at least one active app with a required level.
prefix: The installation opens for customers only when the bank has at least one active app with a required level.

text: Here that app is the mobile bank.

text: Until then, the platform refuses every journey.

text: The admin panel also lists each policy and text that still has its default value, so the bank sees what it has not decided yet.

text: Stage, in the test zone, goes first.
prefix: Stage, in the test zone, goes first.

text: And here is one more fact about Aziz: he is not a real person.
prefix: And here is one more fact about Aziz: he is not a real person.

text: The test team needs him every day, so in stage he is a test identity.
prefix: The test team needs him every day, so in stage he is a test identity.

text: A test identity is a record in the MyID test environment, with a known result: success, or a named failure, such as a face that does not match.
prefix: A test identity is a record in the MyID test environment, with a known result: success, or a named failure, such as a face that does not match.

text: Each night, the acceptance tests run in stage against these test identities.
prefix: Each night, the acceptance tests run in stage against these test identities.

text: Stage connects only to the MyID test environment, and each customer that it creates carries a test mark.
prefix: Stage connects only to the MyID test environment, and each customer that it creates carries a test mark.

text: Limits and reports never count test customers.
prefix: Limits and reports never count test customers.

text: Production connects only to the real MyID, and there every customer is a real person, even the people that the bank uses for its own checks.
prefix: Production connects only to the real MyID, and there every customer is a real person, even the people that the bank uses for its own checks.

text: No network route joins the two zones.
prefix: No network route joins the two zones.

text: Only configuration moves from stage to production, as a difference that a second person approves.
prefix: Only configuration moves from stage to production, as a difference that a second person approves.

text: Customers, devices, sessions and audit events never move.

text: And production guards itself: it does not start with a test address for MyID, or when test customers are allowed.
prefix: And production guards itself: it does not start with a test address for MyID, or when test customers are allowed.

text: Its database refuses any customer with the test mark.

text: Developers do not wait for a zone.

text: The same stack runs on a laptop with one command.

text: The simulators of Lesson 5 play MyID, TAF, the SMS vendor and the push service, so the tests run with no internet.

text: On the laptop, Aziz is a simulator that never gets tired.

text: The contracts of both gateways are published.
